evidence_level: exposed exploratory development; no fresh confirmation

hypotheses.A: Fixed pretreatment controls or exact-condition information improves prediction beyond measured singles and tuned shared correction
hypotheses.B: Symmetric pair-specific kernels add incremental predictive value beyond nonlinear shared distortion
hypotheses.C: Optimization, rank or regularization explains the neural deficit within this bounded menu

allowed_information: Genetic development profiles only. EmeraldBay fitting pairs only, with measured exact-dose singles and pretreatment controls in declared contexts. No evaluator or calibration outcomes, no external pretrained resources.
preprocessing: Prepared gene panels and assay-specific transforms retained; all new feature scales and control PCs fitted on inner/outer source rows. EmeraldBay legacy query-control gene-panel adaptation declared.
splits: Genetic: three random and three partner outer folds; two matched inner folds. Neural audit random only. EmeraldBay: leave each of six source biological states out; nested whole-state folds. No historic evaluator reopened.
candidate_menu: A: ridge plus three RBF bandwidths times six alphas per information route, including measured-only, no-context, shuffled-context, one-hot identity/renaming and numeric dose/shuffled dose. B: additive, offset, tuned linear/nonlinear global, summed-single, pair-product and mixed kernels. Baseline-only EmeraldBay: source intervention means plus shared residual offset, separately accounted.
control_limits: One-hot bijective identity renaming is mathematically invariant, not semantic destruction. Genetic pretreatment state is constant, so context/dose controls are unavailable. Dose features do not test chemical identity. Constant-dose sci-Plex descriptor controls cannot test chemistry.
endpoint: Equal-condition gene-vector MSE; partner repeats scored per occurrence with unique coverage reported; all models share each fold population
uncertainty: 2000 paired diagnostic bootstrap draws, whole biological-state blocks or crossed genetic target weights; fixed profiles and common-control dependence not independent biological inference
measurement: Two disjoint technical-cell halves: inner-full-reference-selected global configuration fitted separately on each half, evaluated against opposite-half responses/references; preserve full shared single/control matrices. Fixed QC/genes/normalizer, not independent culture validation.
decision_rule: Initial development materiality screen: >=5% relative MSE reduction over inner-selected strongest simple reference. Continuation additionally requires positive paired diagnostic lower bound. No independent confirmation or biological recovery claim follows. Report every smaller/negative effect.

neural.selection: Average two seeds before inner scoring; select each family only on inner ensemble MSE; refit both seeds for median inner-selected stopping epoch; never outer stopping
neural.families: 16 pure-sum shared corrections, 16 symmetric pair heads, original sum_network and network 80-update schedules
neural.profile: Synthetic 105-single/10623-gene, width64/rank16, 20-update CPU probe: 1.3207417 seconds, 686419968 RSS bytes, 186687 parameters. RTX4060 8GB available; CPU float64 chosen to retain existing implementation.
neural.freeze: Before outer scores: <=5400 seconds per genetic dataset, <=8GiB RSS, one CPU thread. Interrupted candidates retained; no grid enlargement. This tests 120 updates, not convergence beyond this cap.

conditional_stages: No learned state expansion, active discovery, scaling or calibrated uncertainty without a favorable registered gate; sealed joint confirmation unavailable in local corpus
